description: With vhyst=0.2 and the retained decision low, a +0.08 V differential (below the +0.1 V shifted threshold) must NOT flip the decision; a +0.12 V differential must flip it. Verified by sampling out after two clock edges with different inputs.
dut: X1 inp inn clk out 0 bhv_comparator_clocked_phys_v1 td=2n tedge=1n vhyst=0.2

relations.derivation: 0.08 V differential < vhyst/2 = 0.1 V shifted threshold, decision stays low.
0.12 V differential > 0.1 V shifted threshold, decision flips high.
